rtt_step_pattern.observation: RTTs in this LAG100_OUT run fall on levels about 20 ms apart: {'126 ms': 19, '146 ms': 62, '166 ms': 80, '186 ms': 84, '206 ms': 84, '226 ms': 63, '246 ms': 18, '266 ms': 4, '486 ms': 1} (counts of the 415 selected values by nearest level). The P95 of 245.415 ms is on the 246 ms level. The same pattern is present in the 9 other runs with 415 selected values: concentration R 0.865 to 0.998, share within 3 ms of the ladder 0.916 to 1.000; this run has R 0.834 and share 0.870.
rtt_step_pattern.measure: Circular concentration of RTT modulo 20 ms (R: 0 = even, 1 = all on one phase) and the share of values within 3 ms of the phase centre (a flat spread would give about 0.30).
rtt_step_pattern.status: Observation only. The cause is not established; an earlier working suspicion is system timing granularity. It is kept as a flag so the thesis analysis does not read the steps as network effects.
